name: xhci98
modified: MODIFIED version of xhci98 1.1.1.0: PCI D0 + Memory Space/Bus Master Enable before the bus-master gate (AMD CPU xHCI 1022:149C), CNR wait, 10 s reset timeout, forced USBLEGSUP handoff, 16 Supported Protocol groups (was 4), xECP chain log, scratchpad cap 256, %SystemRoot%\xhci98.log file sink, polling engine for controllers without a usable interrupt (Parameters PollMode, soft-interrupt timer) (MODIFIED.txt); Windows 98 SE build: no file sink, no registry read, KeSetTimer re-armed per tick, no /GS, PE subsystem 5.00; INF takes usbport.sys/usbhub20.sys from STACK.CAB (the user's USB 2.0 stack cabinet) and binds the USB 2.0 root hub (MODIFIED.txt)

source_archive.note: upstream tag tarball; the usos3 source is this archive plus patches/*.patch applied in order with git apply (build.cmd)
